codes.meaning: Durable evidence shows the operation was not started.
Operation started but durable evidence proves no externally published/observable effect occurred.
Durable evidence proves the operation/result completed.
Operation failed with no externally published/observable effect.
Operation failed after a partial effect such as staging/local partial state.
Available evidence cannot prove completion or no-effect; external reconciliation is required before unsafe retry.
Output bytes exist only in staging and are not a published Artifact.
Immutable blob exists without committed Artifact metadata/publication.
Artifact publication is durably committed and should be reconciled rather than recomputed.
Published Artifact metadata references missing/corrupt content or hash verification failed.
Stable transition ID shows the Task transition committed before response loss.
Stable publication ID shows Artifact publication committed before response loss.
Prior runtime authority is not reusable after recovery.
One-shot/bounded grant consumption is durable and must not be reset due to response loss.
Approval no longer matches current program/provider/destination/resource facts or validity window.
Input Artifact/Object revision/content identity no longer matches the prior attempt binding.
Safe retry/substitution requires a fresh Execution Binding and authority evaluation.
Validated semantic retry/fallback budget has no remaining attempt.
External status/idempotency evidence must be obtained before another consequential operation.
Task/current-state and provenance-head evidence are inconsistent and require reconciliation/failure handling.
Database/blob integrity evidence is insufficient for normal execution; enter maintenance/recovery path.
